department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
beneficiary: Eligible elderly persons, widows, persons with disabilities and eligible households under NSAP components
benefits: Social assistance through eligible NSAP pension and family-benefit components
Includes components such as IGNOAPS, IGNWPS, IGNDPS and National Family Benefit Scheme, subject to current rules
eligibility: Eligibility differs by NSAP component and applicable government criteria, including age, widowhood/disability and household conditions.
required_documents: Identity and age proof as applicable
Other documents required by the implementing authority
application_process: Apply through the relevant state/district/local implementing authority following the current NSAP procedure.
source_type: National Social Assistance Programme, Government of India
